przepis.opis_efektu: Two lines: a small letter-spaced uppercase line on top (white, Nunito 600, about 3vw, letter-spacing .2em) and one big lowercase key word under it in #FCE3D6 that slides up from a mask. Small words appear as spoken; never more than 5 words on screen.
